title: Read summaries, page deliberately, then select full detail
when: A strategy document, Progress Log, QA plan catalog, session roster, steering report, deployment run or launch history is large
need: Routine replies use concise command-specific projections and pages. Write receipts print what changed; --json prints everything. Only oversized registered human reads refuse atomically above 28,000 UTF-8 bytes; the refusal names the field, filter, limit and paging flags that command really has and directs readers to command help for the exact recipe. When the reply has headings, the refusal lists each heading's size and exact --section command; --section prints only that section. Read a message body before acting using its named body read; default message detail previews long bodies and prints short bodies whole. Packet renders list headings and name the full packet read. Deployment lists retain continuation cursors and multi-field get. Run detail defaults to status, stage and member counts with explicit member/blocker recipes. Launch lists default to compact operational/history tables with full launch IDs and cursors; --full restores placement, model and registered-session columns. List reads use --limit/--offset paging and explicitly name the next page when cut short.
surface: CLI help, command results and refusals
recipes: yoke strategy doc get CURRENT-PLAN --project P --section "Live status"
yoke deployment-runs get RUN-ID status current_stage release_lineage
